longBench.placement: Axis is clockwise horizontal player direction. Axis never changes on neighbour updates. Only same type and matching axis connect.
longBench.visuals: 4 models, axis z rotated 90 degrees; 8 source states
longBench.interaction: Sneaking PASS; source accepts either hand and any held item. Only one SitEntity per block, source entity Y=.5 and passenger offset=-.25; X faces SOUTH, Z faces EAST.

ceOptions.factory: SeatBlockBehavior.FACTORY takes optional facing Direction property and seats list.
constraints: SeatBlockBehavior useWithoutItem schedules using captured BlockEntity; plugin should check current identity and protection before seating.
SeatBlockEntityController is final; can instantiate as controller using a SeatBlockBehavior template and call spawnSeat(Player). onRemove destroys seats; unload/lifecycle still needs audit.
Native seat controller maps north=0 south=180 west=270 east=90 yaw, then applies SeatConfig yRot; BukkitSeat adds .6 to seat config Y.
Use only two facing values to encode two axes if reusing native seat direction; avoid declaring unsupported/redundant states.
EnumProperty factory accepts explicit values lists; state checker now handles axis x/y/z.
Bench connection signs differ from TableBehavior; do not reuse its flexible perpendicular/single-segment joining.

eightImmortals.shape: 2x2 horizontal, right_bottom anchor; other cells at left, facing, left+facing.
eightImmortals.placement: Validate all four cells: height, border, replaceability, unobstructed, per-cell mayUseItemAt; plugin must also check protection/region/loaded state and rollback partial failure.
eightImmortals.removal: Removing any part clears only other matching type/facing/part without extra loot; piston BLOCK.
eightImmortals.collision: Full selection cube; collision only y12..16. No tabletop inventory in source.

nextChecks: Seat mount cancellation, reentry and block replacement/unload must not leave ghost seats.
